details: This package is a self-declared proof-of-concept beacon. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook of "node index.js", and index.js generates a random UUID, reads the machine hostname and current working directory, and POSTs a JSON body {"event":"authorized-poc-test","testId":"<uuid>","status":"executed"} to hxxps://webhook[.]site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50 at install time. The only data transmitted is that test id and status flag; the host detail is only logged locally with a "[POC]" prefix. No environment variable values, credentials, tokens, wallet data, SSH/AWS configuration or file contents are read or sent, and the package contains no other code. Callback IOC: hxxps://webhook[.]site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50.
